items.title: Extract phase-gates.ts gate runner from story_advance.ts
items.context: Move the transition gate logic into a new packages/main/src/core/phase-gates.ts (or handlers/-adjacent location keeping core/handlers layering correct): REVIEW->TEST CLI preflight gate, the koala validate --json gate, the TEST->DONE done-oracle gate adapter, and the cwd / guard-failure adapter. Behavior-preserving — gate decisions, fail-closed semantics, and error wording stay byte-identical. The validate gate may still write test-evidence.json in this story; annotate it explicitly as a behavior-preserving side effect, do not force it pure here.
items.userSees: A framework maintainer opens packages/main/src/core/phase-gates.ts and finds the transition gate runner: REVIEW->TEST CLI preflight, the koala validate --json gate, the TEST->DONE done-oracle gate adapter, and the cwd/guard-failure adapter. story-advance.ts no longer inlines those gate bodies — it calls phase-gates.ts. npm --prefix packages/main run build is clean with no circular-import error.

happy.desc: core/phase-gates.ts exists exposing the gate runner (REVIEW->TEST preflight, koala validate gate, TEST->DONE done-oracle gate adapter, cwd/guard adapter); build clean

edge.desc: the koala validate gate still writes test-evidence.json — annotated as a behavior-preserving side effect, evidence-write timing unchanged

adversarial.desc: REVIEW->TEST preflight import failure / validate throw / validate JSON-parse failure each still BLOCK TEST — fail-closed default preserved verbatim (preMortem #1)

items.title: Extract transition-effects.ts non-DONE side effects from story_advance.ts
items.context: Move the non-DONE transition side effects into a new packages/main/src/core/transition-effects.ts: process metrics writes, onPhaseChange hooks, REVIEW metadata auto-commit, relatedDocs hint emission, next-step rendering helper. story_advance.ts calls into it. DONE merge / worktree cleanup is explicitly NOT in this module — that is Story 3b. Behavior-preserving: same effects, same order, same output text.
items.userSees: A maintainer opens packages/main/src/core/transition-effects.ts and finds the non-DONE transition side effects: process metrics write, onPhaseChange hooks, REVIEW metadata auto-commit, relatedDocs reminder, next-step rendering. story-advance.ts delegates to it. Running story_advance for a transition emits byte-identical metrics / hook order / auto-commit report / hint text / next-step text as before.

happy.desc: core/transition-effects.ts exists with the non-DONE side effects (metrics / onPhaseChange hooks / auto-commit / relatedDocs hint / next-step rendering); story-advance.ts delegates to it

edge.desc: DONE merge/cleanup is NOT in transition-effects.ts — it stays in story-advance.ts for Story 3b

adversarial.desc: effect order and output text are byte-identical before vs after — a regression snapshot of metrics/hook-sequence/auto-commit/hint/next-step for representative transitions asserts no change (preMortem #3)

items.title: Regression-prove fail-closed gate behavior and zero transition behavior change
items.context: Extend smoke/contract coverage to prove: REVIEW->TEST preflight abnormal cases still fail-closed; koala validate throw / JSON-parse failure still blocks TEST; transition side effects (metrics/hooks/auto-commit/hint) produce identical output before vs after extraction. story_advance.ts no longer contains the inline gate-runner or effect bodies — it delegates to phase-gates.ts / transition-effects.ts.
items.userSees: npm --prefix packages/main run build + test:flow-stability-smoke + test:validation-protocol all green. A regression block proves REVIEW->TEST preflight still fails closed on abnormal cases and koala validate throw / JSON-parse failure still blocks TEST. story-advance.ts line count drops from ~944 and it no longer contains the inline gate-runner or effect bodies.

happy.desc: build + flow-stability-smoke + validation-protocol green; story-advance.ts delegates to phase-gates.ts and transition-effects.ts with no inline gate/effect bodies

edge.desc: new core modules have no circular import — static import-check confirms phase-gates.ts / transition-effects.ts do not import handlers/story-advance.js (preMortem #2)

adversarial.desc: no TEST semantics change, no legacy phase change, no workflow profile change, no DONE merge extraction — git diff scope limited to gate runner + non-DONE effects + tests
